title: Plot 14 is free from April
author: Ruth
text: Plot 14 (by the gate) is free from the start of April. Anyone on the waiting list who wants it, reply here and I will go down the list in order.

title: Blight on the tomatoes by the east fence
author: Tomasz
text: Brown patches on the leaves of the tomatoes along the east fence, and the stems are going dark too. Is this blight? It is only my plot so far.

author: Priya
text: I think I am third on the list. Very interested!

author: Maureen
text: Sounds like blight, sadly. Take off every affected leaf today, bag them, and do not put them in the compost.

author: Olu
text: Second on the list here. Does it come with the water butt?

title: Watering rota for the summer
author: Hannah
text:
Summer watering rota is up in the shed. Two evenings a week each, June to August.
Please put your name in pencil so swaps are easy.

author: Tomasz
text: Done, three bags. Should I pull the plants?

author: Ruth
text: Olu is second, so Olu gets first refusal. Yes, the butt stays with the plot.

author: Kenji
text: Mine two plots down look fine for now. I will keep an eye out. Water at the base, not on the leaves.

title: Compost bays: what can go in
author: Sam
text: What can go in the compost bays? Someone put a whole pizza in bay 2 and now there are rats.

author: Bea
text: Put myself down for Tuesdays and Fridays in June.

author: Maureen
text:
Raw fruit and veg peelings, cardboard, grass cuttings, spent plants (not diseased ones!).
No cooked food, no meat, no dairy.

author: Olu
text: I'll take it, thank you! When can I get a key?

author: Sam
text: Could we put that on a sign by the bays?

title: Shed padlock code changed
author: Ruth
text: The shed padlock code has changed. Message me or Hannah for the new one; please do not post it here.

author: Tomasz
text: It has spread to four plants. Pulling them all.

author: Kenji
text: Messaged you, Ruth.

author: Ruth
text: Olu, key handover Saturday at 10 by the gate.

title: Seed swap, Saturday 10am
author: Priya
text: Seed swap next Saturday, 10am in the shed. Bring anything you saved last year, labelled with the variety and year.

author: Bea
text: I have loads of borlotti beans and some calendula.

author: Hannah
text: Sign is up, laminated. Also moved the rat trap next to bay 2.

author: Olu
text: New plot holder here, I have nothing to swap yet. Can I still come?

author: Priya
text: Of course, that is the whole point.

title: Slugs ate every lettuce seedling
author: Olu
text: Planted a row of lettuce seedlings on Sunday. This morning every single one is gone. Slugs, I assume?

author: Kenji
text: Welcome to plot 14. Beer traps work for me: a jam jar sunk to the rim.

author: Maureen
text: Nematodes if you can afford them. And go out with a torch after dark for a week.

author: Tomasz
text: Could someone swap my 16 July with me? I am away that week.

author: Sam
text: Copper tape round the raised beds did nothing for me, for what it is worth.

author: Kenji
text: Spoke too soon. Blight on mine too now. Removing leaves.

author: Ruth
text: Two plots with blight now. Please nobody take tomato cuttings from the east side this year.

author: Bea
text: I can take 16 July, Tomasz.

title: Rainwater butts overflowing onto path
author: Hannah
text: The water butts by the shed overflow onto the path every time it rains. It is a mud slide.

author: Sam
text: We could fit a diverter and run the overflow to the pond.

author: Olu
text: Torch patrol found 40 slugs in one evening. Replanted under fleece.

author: Ruth
text: A diverter kit is about 20 pounds. Committee agrees, go ahead Sam and keep the receipt.

author: Priya
text:
Thanks all, 14 people came and we swapped over 60 packets.
Leftovers are in the tin on the top shelf.

author: Sam
text: Diverter fitted, overflow now goes to the pond. Receipt is in the shed tin.

author: Sam
text: Pizza box in bay 2 again this week.

author: Ruth
text: I will mention it at the AGM. Bay 2 closed until the rats are gone.

author: Hannah
text: Path is dry after last night's rain. Thank you Sam!

author: Olu
text: Lettuce under fleece is still there after a fortnight.

author: Tomasz
text: Replanted with blight-resistant varieties from the seed swap. Fingers crossed.
